Bill.BriefDescription: Reflecting the impact on property values of governmental restrictions that prevent the property owner from exercising certain groundwater rights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reflecting the impact on property values ofgovernmental restrictions that prevent the property owner fromexercising certain groundwater rights; adding a new section to chapter84.40 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The county assessor must reduce the fair market value of realproperty to reflect the impact of restrictions or emergency rulesimposed by the department of ecology that result in the real propertyowner being unable to fully exercise a groundwater right exempt fromthe permit requirement under RCW 90.44.050. The levy for each taxingdistrict in any year must be reduced as necessary to prevent reductionsunder this section from resulting in a higher tax rate than would haveoccurred in the absence of the reductions under this section.
This act applies to taxes levied for p. 1 HB 2668collection in 2011 and thereafter.
